title: Head positions remain within a time box
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, $a$ a state, $E$ a set of optional states, and $P$ a property of work-head positions. If $c$ and $c'$ form a round of duration $t$, then they also form a round of duration $t$ in which, at every time $u\le t$, each work-tape head position lies between its initial position minus $t$ and its initial position plus $t$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a set of optional states
$P$ is a property of work-head positions
